name: Create restore point
description: Turns on System Restore for C: and saves a restore point, so today's changes can be rolled back.
args: Enable-ComputerRestore -Drive 'C:\' -ErrorAction Stop; Checkpoint-Computer -Description 'MendKit before repair' -RestorePointType 'MODIFY_SETTINGS' -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output 'Restore point saved (Windows keeps at most one per 24 hours).'

friendly.title: Safety restore point
friendly.ok: A restore point was saved, so today's changes can be undone.
friendly.problem: A restore point could not be saved in time, so the repair did not go ahead. This often happens while a Windows update is waiting for a restart. Restart the computer and try again.

name: Check drive health
description: Reads each drive's health status. Repairs stop here if a drive is failing.
args: $d = Get-PhysicalDisk; $d | Format-Table FriendlyName, MediaType, HealthStatus, OperationalStatus -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 200; if ($d | Where-Object { $_.HealthStatus -ne 'Healthy' }) { Write-Output 'One or more drives report a problem. Back up or image the drive before running repairs.'; exit 2 } else { exit 0 }

exitNotes.2: A drive reports a health problem

friendly.title: Drive health
friendly.ok: Your drives report that they are healthy.
friendly.problem: A drive is reporting a problem. Back up your important files as soon as you can.

name: Stopped automatic services
description: Lists services that should start with Windows but stopped with an error. Services that simply wait until they are needed are left out.
args: $ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $s=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Service | Where-Object { $_.StartMode -eq 'Auto' -and $_.State -ne 'Running' -and $_.ExitCode -notin 0,1077 }); $s | Format-Table Name, DisplayName, State, ExitCode -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 200; "FAILED_SERVICES: $($s.Count)"

friendly.title: Background services
friendly.ok: Background services were checked.
friendly.problem: Background services could not be checked.

notes.message: $1 background services that should be running have stopped with an error. The full log names them.

name: Battery report
description: Saves a battery wear report to the temp folder.

friendly.title: Battery
friendly.ok: A battery report was saved.
friendly.problem: This computer has no battery to report on, or the report could not be saved.

name: Reset the print queue
description: Stops the print service, clears stuck jobs and starts it again.
args: $ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; Stop-Service Spooler -Force; Remove-Item "$env:SystemRoot\System32\spool\PRINTERS\*" -Recurse -Force; Start-Service Spooler; Get-Printer | Format-Table Name, PrinterStatus, DriverName -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 200; if ((Get-Service Spooler).Status -ne 'Running') { exit 1 }

friendly.title: Print queue
friendly.ok: Stuck print jobs were cleared and the print service was restarted. Try printing again.
friendly.problem: The print service could not be restarted.

name: List printers
description: Shows installed printers and whether Windows can reach them.
args: $ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; Get-Printer | Format-Table Name, PrinterStatus, PortName, DriverName -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 200; $d=(Get-CimInstance Win32_Printer | Where-Object Default).Name; "Default printer: $d"

friendly.title: Installed printers
friendly.ok: Installed printers were listed.
friendly.problem: Printers could not be listed.

notes.message: A printer shows as offline or in error. Check that it is switched on and on the same network, then try again.

name: Restart the sound services
description: Restarts the Windows audio services.
args: $ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; Restart-Service AudioEndpointBuilder -Force; Start-Service Audiosrv; Start-Sleep 2; Get-Service Audiosrv, AudioEndpointBuilder | Format-Table Name, Status -AutoSize | Out-String; if ((Get-Service Audiosrv).Status -ne 'Running') { exit 1 }

friendly.title: Sound services
friendly.ok: The sound services were restarted. Try playing something again.
friendly.problem: The sound services could not be restarted.

name: Check sound devices
description: Lists speakers and microphones and re-enables any that are turned off.
args: $ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $d=Get-PnpDevice -Class AudioEndpoint, MEDIA -PresentOnly; $d | Format-Table Status, Class, FriendlyName -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 200; $off=$d | Where-Object { $_.Status -ne 'OK' }; foreach ($x in $off) { Enable-PnpDevice -InstanceId $x.InstanceId -Confirm:$false; "Re-enabled: $($x.FriendlyName)" }; if (-not $d) { 'NO_SOUND_DEVICE' }

friendly.title: Speakers and microphones
friendly.ok: All sound devices are working.
friendly.problem: Sound devices could not be checked.

notes.message: Windows does not see any sound device. The sound driver may be missing.

name: Restart Bluetooth
description: Restarts the Bluetooth service and re-enables the Bluetooth radio.
args: $ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; Restart-Service bthserv -Force; $d=Get-PnpDevice -Class Bluetooth -PresentOnly; $d | Where-Object { $_.Status -ne 'OK' } | ForEach-Object { Enable-PnpDevice -InstanceId $_.InstanceId -Confirm:$false; "Re-enabled: $($_.FriendlyName)" }; $d | Format-Table Status, FriendlyName -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 200; if (-not $d) { 'NO_BLUETOOTH' }

friendly.title: Bluetooth
friendly.ok: Bluetooth was restarted. Try connecting the device again.
friendly.problem: Bluetooth could not be restarted.

notes.message: This computer has no Bluetooth radio that Windows can see.

name: Check the camera
description: Checks the camera privacy switch and re-enables a camera that is turned off.
args: $ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $v=(Get-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\CapabilityAccessManager\ConsentStore\webcam').Value; "Camera privacy setting: $v"; $d=Get-PnpDevice -Class Camera, Image -PresentOnly; $d | Format-Table Status, FriendlyName -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 200; $d | Where-Object { $_.Status -ne 'OK' } | ForEach-Object { Enable-PnpDevice -InstanceId $_.InstanceId -Confirm:$false; "Re-enabled: $($_.FriendlyName)" }; if (-not $d) { 'NO_CAMERA' }

friendly.title: Camera
friendly.ok: The camera is present and allowed.
friendly.problem: The camera could not be checked.

notes.message: Windows does not see a camera. Check for a privacy shutter or a camera key on the keyboard.
Camera access is turned off in Windows privacy settings. Turn it on under Settings, Privacy and security, Camera.
The camera was turned off and has been turned back on.

name: Restart Wi-Fi
description: Restarts the Wi-Fi service and asks the router for a fresh address.
args: $ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; if (-not (Get-NetAdapter | Where-Object { $_.PhysicalMediaType -match '802\.11|Wireless' })) { 'NO_WIFI_ADAPTER'; exit 0 }; Restart-Service WlanSvc -Force; Start-Sleep 5; ipconfig /renew | Out-Null; netsh wlan show interfaces

friendly.title: Wi-Fi
friendly.ok: Wi-Fi was restarted.
friendly.problem: Wi-Fi could not be restarted.

notes.message: This computer has no Wi-Fi adapter, or it is switched off or disabled. If it uses a network cable, run "Check my network" instead.
Wi-Fi restarted but is not connected to a network. Choose your network from the Wi-Fi list.

args: $ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; Get-NetAdapter -Physical | Format-Table Name, InterfaceDescription, Status, LinkSpeed -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 200; if (-not (Get-NetAdapter -Physical | Where-Object Status -eq 'Up')) { 'NO_LINK' }

friendly.title: Network connection

notes.message: No network adapter is connected. Check the cable, or that Wi-Fi is switched on and joined to a network.

args: $ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $r=Get-NetRoute -DestinationPrefix '0.0.0.0/0' | Sort-Object { $_.RouteMetric + $_.InterfaceMetric } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $r) { 'CONN_NONE'; exit 0 }; $a=Get-NetAdapter -InterfaceIndex $r.ifIndex; if (-not $a) { 'CONN_OTHER ' + $r.InterfaceAlias; exit 0 }; if ($a.PhysicalMediaType -match '802\.11|Wireless') { 'CONN_WIFI ' + $a.Name; netsh wlan show interfaces } elseif ($a.PhysicalMediaType -match '802\.3') { 'CONN_WIRED ' + $a.Name + ' LINK ' + $a.LinkSpeed } else { 'CONN_OTHER ' + $a.Name + ' (' + $a.InterfaceDescription + ')' }

name: Check for a backup
description: Looks for File History and OneDrive folder backup.
args: $ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $f=@(); $fh=Get-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\FileHistory'; if ($fh -and $fh.ProtectedUpToTime) { $f+=('File History, last saved ' + [DateTime]::FromFileTime($fh.ProtectedUpToTime).ToString('yyyy-MM-dd')) }; Get-ChildItem 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\OneDrive\Accounts' | ForEach-Object { $p=Get-ItemProperty $_.PSPath; if ($p.KfmFoldersProtectedNow -gt 0) { $f+='OneDrive folder backup' } }; if ($f.Count) { 'BACKUP_FOUND: ' + (($f | Select-Object -Unique) -join ' and ') } else { 'NO_BACKUP' }

friendly.title: Backup
friendly.ok: Backup settings were checked.
friendly.problem: Backup settings could not be checked.

notes.message: A backup is set up: $1.

name: Reset Windows Update
description: Stops the update services, sets aside the download cache and starts them again.
args: $ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; Stop-Service wuauserv, bits, cryptsvc -Force; $s="$env:SystemRoot\SoftwareDistribution"; if (Test-Path $s) { Rename-Item $s ("SoftwareDistribution.old-" + (Get-Date -Format yyyyMMddHHmmss)) }; Start-Service cryptsvc, bits, wuauserv; Get-Service wuauserv, bits | Format-Table Name, Status -AutoSize | Out-String; if (Test-Path $s) { 'CACHE_STILL_THERE' }

friendly.title: Windows Update reset
friendly.ok: Windows Update was reset. Open Windows Update and check for updates again.
friendly.problem: Windows Update could not be reset.

notes.message: The update services were restarted, but the old download cache could not be set aside because it was in use. Restart the computer and run this again.

name: Recent crashes and errors
description: Lists blue screens, unexpected shutdowns and serious errors from the last week.
args: $ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $since=(Get-Date).AddDays(-7); $b=@(Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; Id=1001; ProviderName='Microsoft-Windows-WER-SystemErrorReporting'; StartTime=$since}); $k=@(Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; ProviderName='Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Power'; Id=41; StartTime=$since}); $a=@(Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Application'; ProviderName='Application Error'; Id=1000; StartTime=$since}); "BLUESCREENS: $($b.Count)"; "UNEXPECTED_SHUTDOWNS: $($k.Count)"; "APP_CRASHES: $($a.Count)"; $b | Select-Object -First 5 | ForEach-Object { $_.TimeCreated.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') + '  ' + ($_.Message -split "`n")[0] }; $a | Group-Object { $_.Properties[0].Value } | Sort-Object Count -Descending | Select-Object -First 5 | ForEach-Object { 'Crashing app: ' + $_.Name + ' (' + $_.Count + ' times)' }; Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; Level=1,2; StartTime=$since} -MaxEvents 15 | Format-Table TimeCreated, ProviderName, Id -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 200

friendly.title: Crashes in the last week
friendly.ok: No blue screens or unexpected shutdowns in the last week.
friendly.problem: The crash history could not be read.

notes.message: Windows blue-screened $1 times in the last week. A technician should read the log to find the driver or part responsible.

name: Back up installed drivers
description: Copies every third-party driver to Public Documents, so they can be put back after a reinstall.
args: $d=Join-Path $env:PUBLIC 'Documents\MendKit Driver Backup'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $d | Out-Null; pnputil.exe /export-driver * $d | Select-Object -Last 4; $n=@(Get-ChildItem $d -Directory).Count; "DRIVERS_SAVED: $n in $d"; if ($n -eq 0) { exit 1 }

friendly.title: Driver backup
friendly.ok: The drivers were backed up.
friendly.problem: The drivers could not be backed up.

notes.message: $1 drivers were saved to the "MendKit Driver Backup" folder in Public Documents. After a reinstall, point Device Manager at that folder to restore them.
